thread:
maria-finance: Invoice NL-223 from Nordic Logs AS shows 25% MVA/VAT, dated 2026-03-10. AP ticket has PDF. We expected a net invoice (reverse-charge). Can someone advise next step?
chris-legal: Norway is not in the EU VAT scheme. Ask them for their Norwegian VAT (MVA) number and a current business registration extract. If they are VAT-registered we may reclaim; if not, they may have incorrectly charged VAT.
ashley-sales: Spoke to their rep — they say it was added by mistake and they can reissue. They asked for a short template email.
maria-finance: Drafting a request: ask for either (1) reissued invoice without MVA and note "reverse charge - recipient liable" OR (2) provide MVA number + business extract so AP can process. Also request bank details confirmation.
chris-legal: Template suggestion: "Please reissue NL-223 without Norwegian VAT and include 'Reverse charge - recipient liable for VAT' or provide your Norwegian VAT registration number (MVA) plus business extract. If you cannot, please issue a credit note referencing NL-223."
oliver-finance: Approve AP hold while we wait for docs. Put a 30-day cap before escalation.
procurement: If they push back procurement will request contract amendment to enforce net pricing. Tag procurement on vendor thread.
tax-bot: Vendor record missing VAT_registration_number and business_certificate fields. Attach docs to vendor profile to clear hold.
maria-finance: Sent vendor email, copied legal/sales/procurement. AP ticket moved to hold. Will update here when we get reissue or documents.
maria-finance: Checklist: 1) vendor reissue or provide MVA + extract; 2) treasury confirm bank details on reissue; 3) AP reprocess net invoice and reverse VAT; 4) update vendor record.
chris-legal: Keep place-of-supply reasoning in AP ticket for audit trail.
maria-finance: Also — if we find other invoices from Nordic Logs in last 6 months with VAT charged, flag them so we can request batch credits.
